cn: 反对， 不赞成； 反对， 不赞成
enDef: to feel or say that you oppose or disapprove of something

example.en: If no one objects, I would like Mrs Harrison to be present.
example.cn: 如果没人反对的话，我想请哈里森夫人出席。

cn: 命令；顺序；规则；[贸易] 定单
enDef: the way that things or events are arranged in relation to each other, so that one thing is first, another thing is second etc

example.en: There seemed to be no logical order to the sections.
example.cn: 这几部分似乎没有逻辑顺序。

cn: 外出的， 离开的； 即将离职的； 友好的， 好交际的； 外向的
enDef: someone who is outgoing likes to meet and talk to new people

example.en: We’re looking for someone with an outgoing personality.
example.cn: 我们在找一个性格外向的人。

cn: 军官，警官；公务员，政府官员；船长
enDef: someone who is in a position of authority in the army, navy etc

example.en: a commanding officer of the SAS
example.cn: 英国空军特种部队的一名指挥官

enDef: if something happens often, it happens regularly or many times

example.en: She often works at the weekend.
example.cn: 她周末经常要上班。

enDef: someone who owns something

example.en: He was now the proud owner of a bright red sports car.
example.cn: 他现在拥有了一辆亮红色跑车，很是自豪。

enDef: to do what someone in authority tells you to do, or what a law or rule says you must do

example.en: The little boy made no effort to obey.
example.cn: 这小男孩不肯服从。

enDef: as different as possible from something else

example.en: I thought the medicine would make him sleep, but it had the opposite effect.
example.cn: 我以为这药会让他睡觉，但是它却起了反作用。

enDef: a long thick warm coat

example.en: I sprang 400 pounds for  her overcoat.
example.cn: 给她买那件大衣，我花了400镑。

cn: 冒犯， 得罪； 伤害…的感情； 使厌恶， 使不舒服； 违犯， 违反
enDef: to make someone angry or upset by doing or saying something that they think is rude, unkind etc

example.en: His remarks deeply offended many Scottish people.
example.cn: 他的话严重冒犯了许多苏格兰人。

enDef: not inside a building

example.en: We turned off the outside lights and went to bed.
example.cn: 我们关掉外头的电灯，上床睡觉了。

enDef: used to mean someone or something of a type that has already been mentioned or is known about

example.en: ‘Have you got a camera?’ ‘No.’ ‘You should buy one’ (= buy a camera ).
example.cn: “你有照相机吗？”“没有。”“你应该买一架。”

enDef: You use other to refer to an additional thing or person of the same type as one that has been mentioned or is known about

example.en: They were just like any other young couple.
example.cn: 他们那时就和其他任何年轻夫妇一样。

enDef: in or to a particular house, city etc

example.en: You really should come over and see our new house.
example.cn: 你真的该过来看看我们的新房子。

enDef: a chance to do something or an occasion when it is easy for you to do something

example.en: There are fewer opportunities for new graduates this year.
example.cn: 今年新毕业的大学生就业机会较少。

enDef: used by the person speaking to show that they and one or more other people are affected by their own action

example.en: We prepared ourselves for the long journey ahead.
example.cn: 我们为将要开始的长途旅行做好了准备。

enDef: on one occasion only

example.en: I’ve only met her once.
example.cn: 我只见过她一面。

enDef: the tenth month of the year, between September and November

example.en: Most seasonal hiring is done in early October.
example.cn: 多数季节性招聘是在10月初进行。

cn: 出现；在外；出局；出声地；不流行地
enDef: not inside a building

example.en: Many of the homeless have been sleeping out for years.
example.cn: 许多无家可归者常年露宿街头。

enDef: used between two words or phrases to show that either of two things is possible, or used before the last in a list of possibilities or choices

example.en: Shall we go out to the cinema or stay at home?
example.cn: 我们是出去看电影还是待在家里？

enDef: the thick dark liquid from under the ground from which petrol is produced

example.en: a rise in the price of oil
example.cn: 石油价格的上涨

cn: 办公室；政府机关；官职；营业处
enDef: a room where someone has a desk and works, on their own or with other people

example.en: the manager’s office
example.cn: 经理办公室

enDef: a musical play in which all of the words are sung

example.en: We go to the opera (= go to a performance of opera ) regularly.
example.cn: 我们常去听歌剧。

enDef: existing, happening, or used outside, not inside a building

example.en: Though with the widespread of the Internet, we can almost do everything at home, we have to enjoy our outdoor lives.
example.cn: 虽然随着互联网的普及，我们在家几乎可以做所有的事情，但是我们得要欣赏我们的户外生活。

enDef: a round fruit that has a thick orange skin and is divided into parts inside

example.en: I like the orange coat.
example.cn: 我喜欢这个橙色的外套。

cn: 在线的； 联机的， 联网的
enDef: connected to other computers through the Internet, or available through the Internet

example.en: All the city’s schools will be online by the end of the year.
example.cn: 到年底，市里的所有学校都会连接因特网。

cn: 操作， 运转， 经营； 手术； 行动， 活动； 运算
enDef: the process of cutting into someone’s body to repair or remove a part that is damaged

example.en: The firm set up its own property development operation.
example.cn: 这家商行成立了自己的房地产开发公司。

cn: 开着的； 公开的； 坦率的； 开阔的； 开始营业的； 空缺
enDef: not closed, so that things, people, air etc can go in and out or be put in and out

example.en: He threw the door open and ran down the stairs.
example.cn: 他猛地打开门，往楼下跑去。

enDef: used to say how much of something someone has

example.en: How are you off for sports equipment? (= do you have enough? )
example.cn: 你的体育运动装备够不够？

enDef: used to show what a part belongs to or comes from

example.en: the back of the house
example.cn: 房子的后部

enDef: to ask someone if they would like to have something, or to hold something out to them so that they can take it

example.en: A number of groups offer their services free of charge.
example.cn: 一些团体免费提供服务。

enDef: satisfactory but not extremely good

example.en: ‘How was the film?’ ‘It was okay, but not brilliant.’
example.cn: “电影怎么样？”“还算可以，但谈不上很好。”

enDef: something that is old has existed or been used for a long time

example.en: a pair of old shoes
example.cn: 一双旧鞋

cn: 向前地；作用中，行动中；继续着
enDef: used to say what part of someone or something is hit or touched

example.en: I wanted to punch him on the nose.
example.cn: 我真想一拳打到他鼻子上。

enDef: the reflexive form of one27

example.en: It is only through study that one really begins to know oneself.
example.cn: 只有通过学习，一个人才能真正了解自己。

enDef: not more than a particular number, age etc

example.en: Naomi was only 17 when she got married.
example.cn: 娜奥米结婚时才17岁。

example.en: They partook of our triumph.
example.cn: 他们分享我们的胜利。

enDef: used to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with us

example.en: I’ll show you to your room. Ours is next door.
example.cn: 我带你去你的房间，我们的房间在你的隔壁。

enDef: your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject

example.en: When choosing an insurance policy it’s best to get an independent opinion.
example.cn: 选择保险时，最好听听专家的独立意见。

enDef: to have something which belongs to you, especially because you have bought it, been given it etc and it is legally yours

example.en: The building is owned by the local council.
example.cn: 这幢大楼归地方议会所有。

cn: 最初的，原始的；新颖的，有创意的；原创性的
enDef: existing or happening first, before other people or things

example.en: The land was returned to its original owner.
example.cn: 这块土地归还给了原主。

cn: 杰出的； 明显的； 未解决的； 未偿付的
enDef: extremely good

example.en: an outstanding example of a 13th-century castle
example.cn: 13世纪城堡的杰出典范

enDef: a large tree that is common in northern countries, or the hard wood of this tree

example.en: an oak door
example.cn: 橡木门

cn: 动手术； 起作用； 经营， 管理
enDef: to cut into someone’s body in order to repair or remove a part that is damaged

example.en: Doctors had to operate to remove the bullet.
example.cn: 医生不得不开刀取出子弹。

cn: 洋， 海洋； 许多， 大量
enDef: the great mass of salt water that covers most of the Earth’s surface

example.en: She stood on the beach, gazing at the ocean.
example.cn: 她站在海滩上，凝视着大海。

enDef: to or in a foreign country that is across the sea

example.en: Chris is going to work overseas.
example.cn: 克里斯要去国外工作。

enDef: a round white vegetable with a brown, red, or white skin and many layers. Onions have a strong taste and smell.

example.en: Chop the onions finely.
example.cn: 把洋葱切碎。

cn: 组织， 安排； 使有条理； 使有机化
enDef: to make the necessary arrangements so that an activity can happen effectively

example.en: The course was organized by a training company.
example.cn: 这一课程是由一家培训公司组织的。

enDef: if something is optional, you do not have to do it or use it, but you can choose to if you want to

example.en: three optional courses
example.cn: 三门选修课

enDef: outside, not in a building

example.en: It’s warm enough to eat outdoors tonight.
example.cn: 今晚很暖和，可以在户外用餐。

cn: 明显的， 显而易见的
enDef: easy to notice or understand

example.en: The obvious way of reducing pollution is to use cars less.
example.cn: 减少污染显而易见的办法就是少用汽车。

enDef: a brooch or clasp set with gems

example.en: Ouch! That hurt!
example.cn: 哎唷！ 好疼！

enDef: a bull whose sex organs have been removed, often used for working on farms

cn: 欠；感激；应给予；应该把……归功于
enDef: to need to pay someone for something that they have done for you or sold to you, or to need to give someone back money that they have lent you

example.en: How much do I owe you (= often used to show that you want to pay for something )?
example.cn: 我该付你多少钱？

cn: 组织者；发起人；形成体（等于organizer）
犯罪； 过错； 冒犯； 攻击
enDef: when you offend or upset someone by something you do or say

example.en: Don’t be upset by what he said; he meant no offence (= did not intend to offend anyone ).
example.cn: 不要为他的话而生气，他并没有冒犯谁的意思。

cn: 向外的；外面的；公开的；外服的；肉体的
enDef: relating to how a person or situation seems to be, rather than how it really is

example.en: The economy and outward appearance of the area have changed considerably.
example.cn: 该地区的经济和面貌发生了很大的变化。

enDef: to get something that you want, especially through your own effort, skill, or work

example.en: Evans was trying to obtain a false passport and other documents.
example.cn: 埃文斯当时正试图获取假护照和其他文件。

enDef: a part of the body, such as the heart or lungs, that has a particular purpose

example.en: the liver, heart, and other internal organs
example.cn: 肝脏、心脏及其他内脏器官

example.en: All of us ought to go.
example.cn: 我们大家都应该去。

enDef: the fact of owning something

example.en: The price of home ownership is increasing.
example.cn: 房价在不断上涨。

enDef: a gas that has no colour or smell, is present in air, and is necessary for most animals and plants to live. It is a chemical element: symbol O

example.en: The human brain needs to be without oxygen for only four minutes before permanent damage occurs.
example.cn: 人脑缺氧只需4分钟就会造成永久性损伤。

enDef: to happen

example.en: A third of accidental deaths occur in the home.
example.cn: 有三分之一的意外死亡发生在家里。

cn: 忽略；俯瞰；远眺；检查；高耸于…之上
enDef: to not notice something, or not see how important it is

example.en: It is easy to overlook a small detail like that.
example.cn: 那样的小细节很容易被忽略。

enDef: the curved path travelled by an object which is moving around another much larger object such as the Earth, the Sun etc

example.en: Mars and Earth have orbits which change with time.
example.cn: 火星和地球的轨道随着时间而发生改变。

enDef: on the outside of something

example.en: Remove the tough outer leaves before cooking.
example.cn: 烹煮之前先把外面的老叶子去掉。

enDef: the main ideas or facts about something, without the details

example.en: a research proposal outline
example.cn: 研究计划梗概

enDef: in or under the sea and not far from the coast

example.en: offshore oil fields
example.cn: 近海油田

example.en: Oceania is a separate landmass, but it is separated from Asia by very shallow water.
example.cn: 大洋洲是一块单独的陆地，但它与亚洲之间只隔着很浅的海域。

enDef: believing that good things will happen in the future

example.en: Andrew took a more optimistic view.
example.cn: 安德鲁抱有更为乐观的想法。

example.en: When will you be back in Ottawa?
example.cn: 下次什么时候到渥太华来呀？

cn: 官方的， 政府的； 公务的
enDef: approved of or done by someone in authority, especially the government

example.en: an official investigation into the causes of the explosion
example.cn: 对此次爆炸事件原因的官方调查

enDef: expressing your opinions honestly and directly, even when doing this might annoy some people

example.en: an outspoken critic of the education reforms
example.cn: 对教育改革直言不讳的批评者

cn: 职业， 工作； 占领， 占据
enDef: a job or profession

example.en: Please state your name, address and occupation.
example.cn: 请写明你的姓名、地址和职业。

enDef: the final result of a meeting, discussion, war etc – used especially when no one knows what it will be until it actually happens

example.en: People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
example.cn: 在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

enDef: a short trip that a group of people take for pleasure

example.en: One evening, she made a rare outing to the local night club.
example.cn: 一天晚上，她难得地去了一趟当地的夜总会。

enDef: towards the outside or away from the centre of something

example.en: The door opens outwards.
example.cn: 这门是朝外开的。

enDef: to live or stay in a place

example.en: He occupies the house without paying any rent.
example.cn: 他住在这幢房子里，没有付一分钱房租。

enDef: spoken, not written

example.en: oral history
example.cn: 口述的历史

enDef: used when saying what bad thing will happen if something is not done

example.en: You’ll have to go now, otherwise you’ll miss your bus.
example.cn: 你现在就得走，要不然就赶不上公共汽车了。

enDef: to disagree with something such as a plan or idea and try to prevent it from happening or succeeding

example.en: Congress is continuing to oppose the President’s health care budget.
example.cn: 国会继续反对总统的医疗保健预算。

example.en: Go and open the oval box on the sofa.
example.cn: 去并打开在沙发上的椭圆形的盒子。

enDef: to see and notice some­thing

example.en: Scientists have observed a drop in ozone levels over the Antarctic.
example.cn: 科学家已经观察到南极洲上方的臭氧浓度有所下降。

enDef: the place or situation in which something begins to exist

example.en: The tradition has its origins in the Middle Ages.
example.cn: 这一传统源于中世纪。

cn: 在…之上；对…了解；映射到…上
enDef: used to say that someone or something moves to a position on a surface, area, or object

example.en: She watched him walk onto the platform.
example.cn: 她看着他走上站台。

enDef: the amount of goods or work produced by a person, machine, factory etc

example.en: Output is up 30% on last year.
example.cn: 产量比去年提高了30%。

enDef: average, common, or usual, not different or special

example.en: It’s just an ordinary camera.
example.cn: 这只是普通的相机。

enDef: an area of land or sea under which there is oil

example.en: The injection technic develops gradually with the deeper exploitation to oilfield.
example.cn: 注水技术是随着油田的深度开采而逐步发展起来的。

enDef: eggs mixed together and cooked in hot fat, sometimes with other foods added

example.en: a cheese omelette
example.cn: 奶酪煎蛋卷

cn: 经营者；操作员；话务员；行家
enDef: someone who operates a machine or piece of equipment

example.en: computers which can be used by untrained operators
example.cn: 未经训练的操作者也可使用的电脑

cn: 战胜， 克服， 胜过
enDef: to fight and win against someone or something

example.en: Australia overcame the Netherlands 2-1.
example.cn: 澳大利亚队2比1战胜了荷兰队。

cn: [五金] 开启工具；开启的人
enDef: a tool that is used to open cans, bottles etc

example.en: a can opener
example.cn: 开罐器

cn: 哦；哎呀（表示惊讶或恐惧等）
enDef: used to show that you are surprised about something

example.en: ‘Frances has left her husband, you know.’ ‘Oh, has she?’
example.cn: “你知道，弗朗西丝跟她丈夫分开了。”“哦，真的吗？”

enDef: someone who is overweight is too heavy and fat

example.en: He is slightly overweight.
example.cn: 他略微超重。

cn: 开始；机会；通路；空缺的职位
enDef: the beginning or first part of something

example.en: There are very few openings in scientific research.
example.cn: 科学研究领域很少有职位空缺。

enDef: a group such as a club or business that has formed for a particular purpose

example.en: The public expect high standards from any large organization.
example.cn: 公众对任何大型机构都期望很高。

enDef: above your head or in the sky

example.en: Bullets whizzed overhead.
example.cn: 子弹嗖嗖地掠过头顶。

enDef: a moral or legal duty to do something

example.en: Employers have an obligation to treat all employees equally.
example.cn: 雇主有责任对所有员工一视同仁。

enDef: something that makes it difficult to achieve some­thing

example.en: The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
example.cn: 这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。

enDef: to come from a particular place or start in a particular situation

example.en: How did the plan originate?
example.cn: 这个计划最早是怎么想到的？

enDef: to think something is better, more important etc than it really is

example.en: He tends to overestimate his own abilities.
example.cn: 他往往高估自己的能力。

enDef: if a river, lake, or container overflows, it is so full that the liquid or material inside flows over its edges

example.en: The drains flooded and water overflowed down the main street.
example.cn: 下水道被淹，水溢到了大街上。

enDef: Overload is also a noun

example.en: 57 percent complained of work overload.
example.cn: 57%的人抱怨工作负担过重。

enDef: to go past a moving vehicle or person because you are going faster than them and want to get in front of them

example.en: He pulled out to overtake the van.
example.cn: 他把车驶出所在车道想超过那辆小货车。

example.en: But the various pros and cons should not blindly overwhelm one another.
example.cn: 但是，众多的利弊得失不应盲目的一个压倒另一个。

example.en: Rural medics get an average stipend of $65 a year, leading some to overcharge their patients.
example.cn: 这些医生每年仅得到65美元，这导致他们向病人高收费。

enDef: An occasion is a time when something happens, or a case of it happening

example.en: I often think fondly of an occasion some years ago in New Orleans.
example.cn: 我经常深情地想起一些年前在新奥尔良所发生的一幕。

enDef: very large or greater, more important etc than any other

example.en: There is overwhelming evidence that smoking damages your health.
example.cn: 有难以辩驳的证据表明吸烟有损健康。

enDef: a choice you can make in a particular situation

example.en: There are a number of options available.
example.cn: 有多种选择。

enDef: if money is owing, it has not yet been paid to the person who should receive it

example.en: You need to pay the amount owing, plus the interest.
example.cn: 你需要付清欠款，外加利息。

example.en: These efforts have led to a growing confidence among the public that corruption is a serious punishable offense in Albania.
example.cn: 这些努力增强了公众的信心，即人们相信，腐败在阿尔巴尼亚是严重犯罪，能够受到惩罚。

enDef: to talk about something in a way that makes it seem more important, serious etc than it really is

example.en: To say that all motorists speed in residential areas is overstating the case.
example.cn: 说所有驾驶员都在住宅区内超速行驶是言过其实了。

enDef: a reason that you have for opposing or disapproving of something, or something you say that expresses this

example.en: Her objection was that he was too young.
example.cn: 她反对的理由是他太小。

enDef: someone who you try to defeat in a competition, game, fight, or argument

example.en: Graf’s opponent in today’s final will be Sukova.
example.cn: 格拉芙今天的决赛对手将是苏科娃。

cn: 冒犯的，无礼的；进攻的，攻击性的
enDef: very rude or insulting and likely to upset people

example.en: I found her remarks deeply offensive.
example.cn: 我觉得她的话令人非常恼火。

enDef: a long pole with a wide flat blade at one end, used for rowing a boat
based on facts, or making a decision that is based on facts rather than on your feelings or beliefs

example.en: Scientists need to be objective when doing research.
example.cn: 科学家做研究时要客观。

enDef: if you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because the situation, the law, a duty etc makes it necessary

example.en: The storm got worse and worse. Finally, I was obliged to abandon the car and continue on foot.
example.cn: 暴风雨越来越猛烈。最终，我被迫弃车徒步前行。

enDef: the process of watching something or someone carefully for a period of time

example.en: He spent two nights under close observation in hospital.
example.cn: 他在医院接受了两个晚上的严密观察。

enDef: someone who regularly watches or pays attention to particular things, events, situations etc

example.en: political observers
example.cn: 政治观察员

enDef: used to mean that a fact can easily be noticed or understood

example.en: We’re obviously going to need more help.
example.cn: 显然我们将需要更多的帮助。

enDef: happening sometimes but not often or regularly

example.en: He made occasional visits to London.
example.cn: 他有时候会去伦敦。

enDef: something that happens

example.en: Complaints seemed to be an everyday occurrence.
example.cn: 投诉似乎成了天天发生的事。

enDef: different from what is normal or expected, especially in a way that you disapprove of or cannot understand

example.en: It was an odd thing to say.
example.cn: 这话说得很奇怪。

enDef: a smell, especially an unpleasant one

example.en: ...the lingering odour of car exhaust.
example.cn: …挥之不去的汽车尾气的独特气味。

enDef: to not include someone or something, either deliberately or because you forget to do it

example.en: Please don’t omit any details, no matter how trivial they may seem.
example.cn: 请不要忽略任何细节，不管它多细小。

enDef: working and ready to be used

example.en: The boat should be operational by this afternoon.
example.cn: 今天下午这艘船应该可以使用了。

enDef: to treat a group of people unfairly or cruelly, and prevent them from having the same rights that other people in society have

example.en: native tribes oppressed by the authorities
example.cn: 受到当局压迫的土著部落

enDef: relating to machines or processes which are concerned with light, images, or the way we see things

example.en: microscopes and other optical instruments
example.cn: 显微镜和其他光学仪器

example.en: He directed an orchestra.
example.cn: 他指挥一个管弦乐队。

enDef: arranged or organized in a sensible or neat way

example.en: She needs to organize her ideas in a more orderly way.
example.cn: 她需要把自己的想法组织得更有条理些。

enDef: rock or earth from which metal can be obtained

example.en: iron ore
example.cn: 铁矿石

enDef: relating to farming or gardening methods of growing food without using artificial chemicals, or produced or grown by these methods

example.en: Organic farming is better for the environment.
example.cn: 有机耕作对环境更有利。

enDef: an animal, plant, human, or any other living thing

example.en: All living organisms have to adapt to changes in environmental conditions.
example.cn: 一切生物都要适应环境条件的变化。

enDef: relating to or from the eastern part of the world, especially China and Japan

example.en: a beautiful oriental rug
example.cn: 漂亮的东方地毯

enDef: a small object that you keep in your house because it is beautiful rather than useful

example.en: a shelf covered with books and ornaments
example.cn: 摆满书籍和装饰品的架子

enDef: a child whose parents are both dead

example.en: The war has left thousands of children as orphans.
example.cn: 这场战争使成千上万的孩子成为孤儿。

enDef: a unit for measuring weight, equal to 28.35 grams. There are 16 ounces in a pound.

example.en: One ounce of almonds contains nearly half the recommended daily amount.
example.cn: 一盎司杏仁大约包含每日需求量的一半。

enDef: a pipe or hole through which something such as a liquid or gas can flow out

example.en: a waste water outlet
example.cn: 污水排放口

enDef: your general attitude to life and the world

example.en: Exercise will improve your looks and your outlook.
example.cn: 运动将会改善你的外在形象和人生态度。

enDef: at or from the beginning of an event or process

example.en: It was clear from the outset that there were going to be problems.
example.cn: 从一开始就很清楚会有问题出现的。

example.en: Mianyang Nanjiao Airport is seated in southern outskirt of Minayang city proper, operating flights to Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou.
example.cn: 绵阳南郊机场位于绵阳南部郊区，有航班开往北京，上海和广州。

enDef: a piece of equipment that food is cooked inside, shaped like a metal box with a door on the front

example.en: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C.
example.cn: 把烤箱预热至200摄氏度。

enDef: heavy cotton trousers with a piece covering your chest, held up by pieces of cloth that go over your shoulders

example.en: The overall cost of the exhibition was £400,000.
example.cn: 展览会的全部费用是40万英镑。

enDef: suddenly or surprisingly quickly

example.en: He became a millionaire overnight.
example.cn: 他一夜之间就成了百万富翁。

example.en: The firm wanted to chisel him out of his overtime pay.
example.cn: 公司想要剥夺他的超时加班费。

enDef: a bird with large eyes that hunts at night

example.en: Some of the more extreme contacts give you "cat eyes" or how about "owl eyes"?
example.cn: 一些更酷的隐形眼镜可以给你一双"猫眼"或者是"猫头鹰的眼睛"。

enDef: furthest from the middle

example.en: the outermost stars
example.cn: 最远的恒星

enDef: the best or most suitable for a particular purpose or in a particular situation

example.en: optimum conditions for growth
example.cn: 最适宜生长的条件

enDef: Something that is ornamental is attractive and decorative

example.en: ...an ornamental fountain.
example.cn: …一个装饰性喷泉。

enDef: not well known and usually not very important

example.en: an obscure poet
example.cn: 名不见经传的诗人

enDef: a substance which is produced when a substance is combined with oxygen

example.en: iron oxide
example.cn: 氧化铁

enDef: to combine with oxygen, or make something combine with oxygen, especially in a way that causes rust

example.en: If the organic material decays or is oxidized, it will not form petroleum.
example.cn: 如果有机物腐烂或氧化，它不会形成石油。

enDef: a powerful illegal drug made from poppy seeds. Drugs made from opium are used to reduce severe pain.

example.en: an opium addict
example.cn: 吸鸦片成瘾者

enDef: to hang over something or stick out above it

example.en: Part of the rock wall overhung the path at one point.
example.cn: 部分岩壁悬在了小径一处的上方。

enDef: the type of activity or subject that a person or organization seems most interested in and gives most attention to

example.en: The company needs to develop a stronger orientation towards marketing its products.
example.cn: 公司需要针对其产品的营销设定一个更为明确的目标。

enDef: a poisonous blue gas that is a type of oxygen

example.en: Objective To observe the disinfection effect of gastroscope by ozone water.
example.cn: 目的观察臭氧水在胃镜体的消毒效果监测。

enDef: when someone is very fat in a way that is unhealthy

example.en: So, what of the future of obesity in America?
example.cn: 那么，未来美国的肥胖状况会怎么发展呢？

enDef: strong disagreement with, or protest against, something such as a plan, law, or system

example.en: He is confident in his ability to overcome all opposition with his personal charm.
example.cn: 他自信有能力以个人魅力来化解一切反对力量。

enDef: to find exactly where you are by looking around you or using a map

example.en: She looked at the street names, trying to orient herself.
example.cn: 她看看街名，试图确定自己的方位。

enDef: if something is outdated, it is no longer considered useful or effective, because something more modern exists

example.en: outdated teaching methods
example.cn: 不合时宜的教学方法

enDef: to remain alive after someone else has died

example.en: She outlived her husband by 20 years.
example.cn: 她比她丈夫多活了20年。

enDef: to be more in number than another group

example.en: Flats outnumber houses in this area.
example.cn: 这个地区公寓房比独栋房子多。

enDef: If a company outsources work or things, it pays workers from outside the company and often outside the country to do the work or supply the things

example.en: ...companies that outsource IT functions.
example.cn: …将信息技术方面的工作外包的公司。

enDef: If one thing outweighs another, the first thing is of greater importance, benefit, or significance than the second thing

example.en: The advantages of this deal largely outweigh the disadvantages.
example.cn: 这笔交易的利远大于弊。

enDef: someone who is overexcited is very excited and not behaving sensibly

example.en: Some of the boys became overexcited.
example.cn: 有些男孩变得兴奋过度了。

enDef: to remove a leader or government from power, especially by force

example.en: Rebels were already making plans to overthrow the government.
example.cn: 反叛者已在密谋颠覆政府。

cn: 传统的； 正统的， 正宗的
enDef: orthodox ideas, methods, or behaviour are accepted by most people to be correct and right

example.en: orthodox medical treatments
example.cn: 传统疗法

cn: 大声疾呼， 呐喊； 强烈抗议
enDef: an angry protest by a lot of ordinary people

example.en: The closure of the local hospital has caused a huge public outcry.
example.cn: 当地医院的关闭激起了大规模的公众抗议。

enDef: usually

example.en: Ordinarily, he didn’t like to go to the movies.
example.cn: 一般来说他不喜欢去看电影。

enDef: someone who has done something illegal, and who is hiding in order to avoid punishment – used especially about criminals in the past

example.en: Jesse was an outlaw, a bandit, a criminal.
example.cn: 杰西曾是个逃犯、土匪、罪犯。

enDef: a formal and very serious promise

example.en: The president took the oath of office (= made the official public promises that every president makes when starting their job ) .
example.cn: 总统宣誓就职。

enDef: a tendency to believe that good things will always happen

example.en: There are grounds for cautious optimism.
example.cn: 有理由保持谨慎乐观。

enDef: to be more successful than someone or something else

example.en: Stocks generally outperform other investments.
example.cn: 股票总体上要优于其他投资。

cn: 全套服装； 一组人； 全套装备， 全套工具
enDef: a set of clothes worn together, especially for a special occasion

example.en: She bought a new outfit for the party.
example.cn: 她为了这次派对买了套新衣服。

enDef: to accidentally hear what other people are saying, when they do not know that you have heard

example.en: I overheard part of their conversation.
example.cn: 我碰巧听到了他们谈话的部分内容。

enDef: a unit for measuring electrical resistance
If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.

example.en: When the bag is folded, the bottom overlaps one side.
example.cn: 把包折叠起来时，其底部与一边就重合了。

enDef: a type of shellfish that can be eaten cooked or uncooked, and that produces a jewel called a pearl

example.en: He had two dozen oysters and enjoyed every one of them.
example.cn: 他吃了两打牡蛎，每一个都吃得津津有味。

enDef: continuing, or continuing to develop

example.en: their ongoing search for a new director
example.cn: 他们仍在寻找一个新主任

enDef: if you overturn something, or if it overturns, it turns upside down or falls over on its side

example.en: Leslie jumped to her feet, overturning her chair.
example.cn: 莱斯莉一跃而起，碰倒了椅子。

enDef: how likely it is that something will or will not happen

example.en: (= it is likely ) that he will commit the same crime again.
example.cn: 他可能还会犯同样的罪行。

enDef: the state of not being known or remembered

example.en: Now, on the eve of the bicentenary of the independence movements, he sets out to rescue San Martín from his relative obscurity.
example.cn: 今天，在那场独立运动二百周年纪念前夕，他再度出手以挽救相对默默无闻的圣·马丁。

enDef: overt actions are done publicly, without trying to hide anything

example.en: an overt attempt to silence their political opponents
example.cn: 他们想压制政敌言论的明显企图

enDef: a structure like a bridge that allows one road to go over another road

example.en: Two cargo trains slammed together at a rail intersection southwest of Cape Girardeau, derailing cars that then struck the support columns of a highway overpass.
example.cn: 两辆货运火车在开普吉拉多西南部的铁路交叉口发生碰撞，部分车厢脱轨，并撞毁了高速公路天桥的支撑柱。

enDef: a place where fruit trees are grown

example.en: a cherry orchard
example.cn: 樱桃园

enDef: determined not to change your ideas, behaviour, opinions etc, even when other people think you are being unreasonable

example.en: He was the most obstinate man I’ve ever met.
example.cn: 他是我遇到过的最固执的人。

enDef: a small bitter egg-shaped black or green fruit, used as food and for making oil

example.en: ...a pile of black olives.
example.cn: …一堆黑橄榄。

enDef: always doing what you are told to do, or what the law, a rule etc says you must do

example.en: an obedient child
example.cn: 听话的孩子

enDef: when someone does what they are told to do, or what a law, rule etc says they must do

example.en: obedience classes for dogs and their owners
example.cn: 为狗和主人安排的服从训练课

example.en: An odor of corruption hangs about him.
example.cn: 他浑身散发着腐化堕落的气味。

enDef: to use one cost, payment or situation in order to cancel or reduce the effect of another

example.en: He was able to offset his travel expenses against tax.
example.cn: 他可以用旅费抵税。

enDef: someone’s child or children – often used humorously

example.en: a young mother trying to control her offspring
example.cn: 一个想管住自己孩子的年轻妈妈

cn: 淫秽的， 下流的； 可憎的， 可恶的
enDef: relating to sex in a way that is shocking and offensive

example.en: Bradford made an obscene gesture.
example.cn: 布拉德福德做了个下流手势。

enDef: (of glass, liquid, etc.) not clear enough to see through or allow light through

example.en: a shower with an opaque glass door
example.cn: 装有不透明玻璃门的淋浴间

enDef: the sudden start of sth unpleasant, especially violence or a disease

example.en: the outbreak of war
example.cn: 战争的爆发

cn: 义愤，愤慨；暴行，骇人听闻的事件
enDef: a feeling of great anger and shock

example.en: The response to the jury’s verdict was one of outrage.
example.cn: 陪审团的裁决引发了愤慨。

enDef: no longer useful, because something newer and better has been invented

example.en: obsolete weapons
example.cn: 已被淘汰的武器

enDef: necessary changes or repairs made to a machine or system

example.en: The car needs a complete overhaul.
example.cn: 这辆汽车需要大修。

cn: 组织， 机构； 体制， 结构
痴迷；困扰；[内科][心理] 强迫观念
enDef: an extreme unhealthy interest in something or worry about something, which stops you from thinking about anything else

example.en: Gambling became an obsession, and he eventually lost everything.
example.cn: 他迷上赌博，最后失去了一切。

enDef: the parts of a town or city that are furthest from the centre

example.en: On the extreme northwestern outskirts of the city stands the Buddhist temple.
example.cn: 那所佛教寺院位于市郊的最西北角。

enDef: an offence in football, hockey etc in which a player gets between an opponent and the ball

example.en: John was irritated by drivers parking near his house and causing an obstruction.
example.cn: 约翰被众司机在他房子附近停车而造成阻塞所激怒。

enDef: to choose one thing or do one thing instead of another

example.en: Depending on your circumstances you can opt for one method or the other.
example.cn: 根据自己的情况，你可以选择这种或那种方法。

enDef: to block a road, passage etc

example.en: A small aircraft was obstructing the runway.
example.cn: 一架小型飞机堵住了跑道。

enDef: If you say that something or someone is overrated, you mean that people have a higher opinion of them than they deserve

example.en: More men are finding out that the joys of work have been overrated.
example.cn: 更多的男士正发现工作的种种乐趣被高估了。

cn: 豪华的， 华丽的， 富裕的； 丰富的， 丰饶的
enDef: very beautiful, with a lot of decoration, and made from expensive materials

example.en: evening dresses in opulent fabrics
example.cn: 用华丽织物做成的晚礼服

cn: 财富， 富裕； 丰富， 富饶
验光师， 视力测定者
enDef: An optometrist is someone whose job is to test people's eyesight to see if they need glasses, and how strong their glasses should be

example.en: "I see what I would consider a normal patient population, representative of the average experience most people are having, " Brooklyn optometrist Justin Bazan, a paid consultant to the Vision Council.
example.cn: “我想我应该考虑哪些是一个正常的患者群体，平均代表有经验的大多数人。” 布鲁克林验光师贾斯汀·巴赞说道，他是视力协会的付费顾问。

enDef: someone who watches something happening without being involved in it

example.en: A crowd of onlookers had gathered at the scene of the accident.
example.cn: 一群旁观者围聚在事故现场。

enDef: the beginning of something, especially something bad

example.en: the onset of winter
example.cn: 冬天的来临

cn: (对品格或忍耐力的)严格考验

example.en: They manned themselves for an ordeal.
example.cn: 他们振奋精神迎接考验。

cn: 使劳累过分；对…使用过度；滥用
enDef: to work too much or to make someone work too much

example.en: You’ve been overworking – why don’t you take a week off?
example.cn: 你最近在超强度工作——为什么不休息一周呢？

enDef: a place with water and trees in a desert

example.en: The immaculately tended gardens are an oasis in the midst of Cairo's urban sprawl.
example.cn: 那些打理得非常整洁的花园是杂乱扩张的开罗市区中的一片绿洲。

enDef: An oblong is a shape which has two long sides and two short sides and in which all the angles are right angles

example.en: ...an oblong table.
example.cn: ...一张长方形桌子。

cn: (法律或道义上)必须的，应尽的
enDef: something that is obligatory must be done because of a law, rule etc

example.en: She offered him the obligatory cup of tea.
example.cn: 她照例给他端来一杯茶。

enDef: willing and eager to help

example.en: The shop assistant was very obliging.
example.cn: 店员非常热情。

enDef: not looking, pointing etc directly at something

example.en: an oblique glance
example.cn: 斜瞥

example.en: She lay motionless where she was, oblivious to pain.
example.cn: 她一动不动地躺在原地，感觉不到疼痛。

enDef: very offensive, unpleasant, or rude

example.en: She’s really obnoxious.
example.cn: 她这人真讨厌。

cn: (法律习俗等)遵守；奉行；礼仪，仪式
enDef: when someone obeys a law or does something because it is part of a religion, custom, or ceremony

example.en: the Memorial Day observance
example.cn: 纪念日的习俗

enDef: a special building from which scientists watch the moon, stars, weather etc

example.en: The reason for this was that he decided to orientate the map in the direction of the Pole Star since Polaris was the immovable guiding light in which the voyagers of that era placed their trust.
example.cn: 他之所以要这样做就是因为他决定以北极星的方向来确定地图的方位。 因为北极星是一盏不动的导航灯，那个时代的航海家们主要依靠北极星来导航。

enDef: to keep changing between one feeling or attitude and another

example.en: The stock market is oscillating wildly at the moment.
example.cn: 股票市场现在正急剧波动。

enDef: seeming to be the reason for or the purpose of something, but usually hiding the real reason or purpose

example.en: The ostensible purpose of these meetings was to gather information on financial strategies.
example.cn: 这些会议声称旨在收集金融策略方面的信息。

enDef: when you deliberately try to show people how rich or clever you are, in order to make them admire you

example.en: Her lifestyle was remarkably free from ostentation.
example.cn: 她的生活方式毫不张扬。

enDef: If someone is ousted from a position of power, job, or place, they are forced to leave it

example.en: The leaders have been ousted from power by nationalists.
example.cn: 那些领导人已被民族主义者赶下了台。

cn: 被遗弃的；被遗弃者，被逐出者
enDef: someone who is not accepted by the people they live among, or who has been forced out of their home

example.en: Smokers often feel as though they are being treated as social outcasts.
example.cn: 吸烟者常常觉得自己遭到社会排斥。

enDef: to be better or more successful than someone else at doing something

example.en: When it comes to speed of response, a small firm can outdo a big company.
example.cn: 说到反应速度，小公司会胜过大公司。

example.en: That is one difference between timeboxed iterations and overlapping iterations.
example.cn: 那是时间框迭代和重叠迭代的一个区别。

enDef: a group of buildings in a place far from cities or towns, usually established as a military camp or a place for trade

example.en: a remote outpost of the empire
example.cn: 帝国的一个偏远村镇

cn: 使客观化； 使具体化； 物化
enDef: to treat a person or idea as a physical object

example.en: a culture that objectifies women
example.cn: 将女性物化的一种文化

enDef: forwards

example.en: He walked onwards to the head of the lake.
example.cn: 他一直向前，走到湖泊源头。

cn: 给…蒙上阴影； 使扫兴； 使黯然失色
enDef: If an unpleasant event or feeling overshadows something, it makes it less happy or enjoyable

example.en: Fears for the president's safety could overshadow his peace-making mission.
example.cn: 对总统安全的担心会给他的和平促进任务蒙上阴影。

enDef: a short description of a subject or situation that gives the main ideas without explaining all the details

example.en: The central section of the book is a historical overview of drug use.
example.cn: 本书的中心部分是对药物使用的一个历史概述。

enDef: if something or someone obsesses you, you think or worry about them all the time and you cannot think about anything else – used to show disapproval

cn: 长途冒险旅行；一连串的冒险
enDef: a long journey with a lot of adventures or difficulties

example.en: a spiritual odyssey
example.cn: 一次精神上的艰难历程

enDef: far from the centre of a city, town etc or from a main building

example.en: one of the outlying suburbs
example.cn: 边远郊区之一

enDef: the amount of money you owe to a bank when you have spent more money than you had in your account

example.en: a £250 overdraft
example.cn: 250英镑的透支额

enDef: very shocking and extremely unfair or offensive

example.en: outrageous prices
example.cn: 骇人的价格

example.en: an outright refusal
example.cn: 断然拒绝

enDef: to do something better than someone else or be more successful

example.en: We outstripped all our competitors in sales last year.
example.cn: 去年我们的销售额超过了所有竞争对手。

enDef: if a group of people give someone an ovation, they clap to show approval

example.en: The Chancellor’s entrance was greeted with a standing ovation (= everyone stood up ).
example.cn: 总理进来时，全体起立鼓掌欢迎。

enDef: not done, paid, returned etc by the time expected

example.en: an overdue gas bill
example.cn: 逾期未付的煤气账单

cn: 装得太多， 装到满溢
enDef: to put too much of something into a container

example.en: He had overfilled the jug.
example.cn: 他把罐子装得太满了。

enDef: to graze (land) beyond its capacity to sustain stock
to be sold in larger quantities than something else

example.en: It may outsell his previous novels.
example.cn: 它的销量有可能超过他以前的几本小说。

example.en: Hunger and poverty often compel the poor to overexploit the resources on which their own livelihoods depend.
example.cn: 饥饿和贫困常常迫使穷人过度开采其赖以生存的资源。

enDef: a sign of what will happen in the future

example.en: The car won’t start. Do you think it’s an omen?
example.cn: 汽车发动不起来。你觉得这是某种预兆吗？

enDef: making you feel that something bad is going to happen

example.en: ‘How long will she be ill?’ he asked. There was an ominous silence.
example.cn: “她的病多久会好？”他问。大家的沉默让人感觉不妙。

cn: 躺在…上面； 置于…上面
enDef: to lie over something

example.en: Clay overlies chalk in the southern mountains.
example.cn: 在南部山脉，黏土层覆在白垩层之上。

example.en: He crashed into an oncoming car.
example.cn: 他撞上了一辆迎面驶来的汽车。

cn: 不理(某人的愿望要求)，不顾

example.en: The EU commission exercised its power to override British policy.
example.cn: 欧盟委员会行使其权力来否决英国的政策。

enDef: to be in charge of a group of workers and check that a piece of work is done satisfactorily

example.en: A team leader was appointed to oversee the project.
example.cn: 任命了一位组长来监管该工程。

enDef: a short piece of music written as an introduction to a long piece of music, especially an opera

example.en: They began making overtures to the Irish government.
example.cn: 他们开始向爱尔兰政府表示友好。

cn: 过分劳累的，过度兴奋的

example.en: Clara was tired and overwrought after all the problems of the last few days.
example.cn: 经历了过去几天的重重困难之后，克拉拉既疲惫又紧张。

enDef: a large violent attack by an army

example.en: The press launched another vicious onslaught on the president.
example.cn: 新闻界对这位总统进行了新一轮的恶毒抨击。

enDef: relating to the eyes

example.en: the optic nerve
example.cn: 视神经
